meta.name: adversarial-analysis
meta.description: Adversarial stress test — three agents (Advocate FOR, Adversary AGAINST, Judicial synthesis with probability). Trigger when: user wants to stress-test a position, check weaknesses before filing, or requests adversarial review. Also option '4' in /legal menu. Do NOT trigger for: initial research (swiss-legal-research), strategy (swiss-legal-strategy), or drafting — this is a quality layer, not first-pass analysis.
